title: Capacity of Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul Sector in Singapore's Aviation Industry Given Resumption of Flights
what_it_is: Capacity of Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul Sector in Singapore's Aviation Industry Given Resumption of Flights

sections.label: Aerospace production and hiring
sections.summary: Industrial production exceeded pre-COVID-19 levels since Q2 2022 and grew 27.7% in 2022, with about 3,000 new aerospace roles to be filled by year-end.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The industry's monthly index of industrial production has exceeded pre-COVID-19 levels since the second quarter of 2022 and grew 27.7% year-on-year in 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We expect MRO demand to grow further as China opens its borders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To cope with this demand, aerospace companies are increasing their recruitment efforts and looking to fill about 3,000 new roles by the end of this year.

sections.label: Aerospace job localisation
sections.summary: The aerospace industry has almost 80% job localisation, mostly PMETs, and the Government works with companies, schools and unions on a local talent pipeline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On the localisation, the aerospace industry has a high rate of job localisation of almost 80%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Majority of them are working as PMETs and the Government is working closely with companies, schools and unions to build a robust local talent pipeline for the sector.

sections.label: Aerospace industry transformation map
sections.summary: The aerospace industry transformation map was launched in October 2022, with plans to 2025 and a target of $4.6 billion in real value-added.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Deputy Prime Minister Heng and I launched our aerospace industry transformation map in October 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: It is a forward-looking map, which has plans for the aerospace industry to 2025 and we hope to achieve $4.6 billion in real value-added by 2025, which is a 15% increase in our target of ITM 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, the aerospace sector is looking bright and I encourage Singaporeans to also apply and join the sector.
